title: Cobblemon Improved+
description: This is a mod pack aimed to improve the mod Cobblemon with all its best community made add-ons + some QOL Mods
body:
![The Modpack Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1f5cbff08f12096e9928b20ea1384f223d59e760.png)

**A Challenging, fun-based modpack to improve cobblemon**
![Spacee](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/be0b57158bc9ad1aa6fa576d8ebcd2c30680a63d.png)
Ah, Cobblemon.. A fun mod that adds the whole Poke'mon™  world to minecraft, but as good as this mod is, **its still in developement.** and therefore is missing alot of fun and unique features. **This Modpack Aims to fix that issue.** Using all of my favourite Cobblemon Addons and some **custom Config** settings. This modpack **Improves Cobblemon** to make a wonderfully fun adventure.
![Spacee](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/be0b57158bc9ad1aa6fa576d8ebcd2c30680a63d.png)
## Modpack Features
- 📺 **Menu** - This modpack includes a custom main menu with its own theme and sounds.
- 🎉 **Pokemon** - This mod obviously contains alot of Poke'mon
- 💢 **Battles** - You can battle a plethora of randomly spawning trainers, theres even a levelling system.
- 🪑 **Furniture** - Using mods like Macaw's Furniture this modpack add alot of options.
- 😊 **Towns** - Using mods like MCA, this mod has cutsom villages, familys, marriage, and more!
- 💯 **Megas** - You can mega evolve Poke'mon using naturally spawning mega stones.
- 🌳 **Ambience** - With a plethora of ambient mods this modpack feels lively and beautiful.
- 💧 **Thirst** - This Pack Contains A thirst system to offset the mob spawning system.
- 😱 **No mobs** - Using "No mob spawning" Nothing that isnt Poke'mon will spawn, only they can hurt you.
- 👻 **Legendaries** - This Pack Has Legendary Poke'mon.
-  🍇 **Food** - You can grow and cook new foods.
- 💿 **Discord Support** - Friends on Discord can see what you are doing and what pack youre playing!

![Spacee](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/be0b57158bc9ad1aa6fa576d8ebcd2c30680a63d.png)
## FAQ

- **Q:** Does this pack support Multiplayer?
**A:** YES!! This pack is built for the best multiplayer adventure, but tested in singleplayer as to make sure they both work quite well.
- **Q:** Where to report bugs?
**A:** Join Our discord and send a message in the Projects Channel.

- **After reading all that, i thank you for playing my modpack, its not perfect but i like it. Thankyou for your support and i hope you have a wonderful day!**
